{{Top|leg}}
'''Kilowarr''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Kilowarr would often smuggle [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] in a [[chidinkalu]], and would often play it during customs inspections to "encourage" the inspection to end early.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
